description: This Java class implements the <clone-value> element for a mini-language used in the Apache OFBiz framework, enabling cloning of GenericValue objects within the mini-language's method processing.

classes.name: CloneValue
classes.description: Implements the <clone-value> element, providing logic to clone a GenericValue object within the mini-language processing.

classes.name: CloneValue.CloneValueFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of the CloneValue operation when processing the <clone-value> element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the cloning operation, retrieving the source GenericValue from the environment map and placing a cloned copy into the environment map at the specified new value field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CloneValue object.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a CloneValue object based on XML element and the surrounding method context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this factory, which is 'clone-value'.
